The '''Sprizen End Run''' was an ancient route in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] from [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]] to [[Sprizen]]. In [[3704 BBY]], the Sprizen End Run was integral in piecing together the future [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], and it was later absorbed into the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA" />
